item.title: Yume to Iro de Dekiteiru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 発売日: 2019-02-22
  • スコア: 7.590000000000001/10 (174 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夢と色でできている
  • 英語名: Yume to Iro de Dekiteiru

别名

  • Our times made of dreams and colour

あらすじ

In their childhood, a group of seven friends called themselves the World Defense Force. Led by Hiiro, the group embarked on adventures together. However, when Hiiro had to move away, she entrusted the leadership to Ai, the protagonist. Sadly, not long after, Ai disbanded the club, and the group gradually lost touch.

item.title: Zutto Mae Kara Joshi Deshita
item.description:

  • スコア: 6.909999999999999/10 (45 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ずっと前から女子でした
  • 英語名: Zutto Mae Kara Joshi Deshita

别名

  • Did you know I was a girl‛？

あらすじ

Haruya’s family runs a group of ryokan and he grew surrounded by women, led by his pushy sisters. He never truly got over his uneasiness around girls, so he had only attended boys’ schools until now. While he was more comfortable around his guy friends, he was at the age where he started to show interest in the opposite sex. He wondered if he could find a girl who was cute and not scary.

item.title: Gakkou no Seiiki
item.description:

  • 日本語名: 学校のセイイキ
  • 英語名: Gakkou no Seiiki

别名

  • Gakkou no Seiiki

あらすじ

This is the third game in feng’s Seiiki series, this time with two heroines instead of just one. Youhei’s older sister Yaeka Nase is his homeroom teacher. She looks dignified as a teacher, and is very popular amongst the students. However, she’s always drunk at home and leads a very loose private life.

item.title: Imouto no Seiiki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: feng
  • 発売日: 2015-08-28
  • スコア: 6.49/10 (474 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹のセイイキ
  • 英語名: Imouto no Seiiki

别名

  • Imouto no Seiiki

あらすじ

This is the second title in feng’s low-price Seiiki series, focusing on younger sister Yukana Nase.

When Youhei was small, he used to visit Akiba often. Even though it was for his younger sister Yukana, he soon got hooked on game centres and that’s how he became friends with his ojou-sama classmate Fuyuka. One day, Fuyuka gifted Yukana with a Christmas trip and the siblings enjoyed their time alone together like a couple. Looking at his younger sister, he realized that still hasn’t saved her from that time.

item.title: Kanojo no Seiiki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: feng
  • 発売日: 2014-12-19
  • スコア: 6.35/10 (780 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 彼女のセイイキ
  • 英語名: Kanojo no Seiiki

别名

  • Kanojo no Seiiki

あらすじ

One day, our hero is headed home from Akihabara when he’s mistaken for a molester. The person accusing him is his childhood friend, Akiyoshi Fuyuka. When they were both children, she was a well-dressed and lovely young rich girl, and the idol of the class. She was the apple of every boy’s eye, but it was impossible to get close to her, our hero included. But our hero was in love with her. He has memories of when he was younger and first felt that way.

item.title: Chiisana Kanojo no Serenade
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: feng
  • 発売日: 2013-10-25
  • スコア: 7.209999999999999/10 (207 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ちいさな彼女の小夜曲
  • 英語名: Chiisana Kanojo no Serenade

别名

  • ちいさな彼女のセレナーデ

あらすじ

The ‘ningyo matsuri’ (mermaid festival) is held every year in the village of Suminoe-chou, which faces the Pacific Ocean. Takumi helps out with his family’s popular cafe Mermaid with his osananajimi Mizuka and his mother Isana.

On the night of the festival, Takumi came upon a girl with a beautiful voice. She was surprised at the unexpected visitor and accidentally slipped into the sea. He saved her and since he couldn’t let her be in her drenched state, he invited the mysterious girl Shione to his house. When Isana decided that Shione would stay in their house and Matsuri, who he had met at the festival, transferred into his school, his days gradually began to change.

item.title: Hoshizora e Kakaru Hashi AA
item.description:

  • ブランド: feng

  • 日本語名: 星空へ架かる橋AA
  • 英語名: Hoshizora e Kakaru Hashi AA

あらすじ

The fandisk for Hoshikaka, containing after stories for the 6 heroines and another stories for new heroine Seira and subchars Senka and Yocchan. The new routes take place one year after Kazuma first came to Yamabiko city. Ui and Hina’s Valentine’s Day routes from the special patch will now be fully voiced, with episodes for other characters coming out too.

item.title: Hoshizora e Kakaru Hashi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • スコア: 7.029999999999999/10 (382 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 星空へ架かる橋
  • 英語名: Hoshizora e Kakaru Hashi

别名

  • Hoshikaka

あらすじ

Kazuma moved to Yamabiko-chou due to his younger brother Ayumu’s health and ended up staying at the Yorozuyo inn, owned by his father’s friend. On his first day at school, he got lost and asked for directions from a fellow student, Ui. She led him on an offbeat path and he accidentally fell and kissed her. Coincidentally, this was all seen by Ui’s friend, Ibuki, who thought he was a bad guy and declared him to be an enemy.

  • 英語名: Akaneiro ni Somaru Saka

别名

  • あか坂

あらすじ

One day, Junichi’s fiancee, Yuuhi, moves to his high school. But, they have a quarrel on the day they first meet. Their parents discuss and order them to go out together once a month to restore their relationship. And if they can’t do that, their engagement will be cancelled. Their school life starts, and various accidents happen… What will happen to their relationship in the end?
